items.summary: Matthias Dolderer joined the Red Bull Air Race in 2008 and spent years building experience, reaching the podium several times by 2015. After that season ended without a title, he took a hard look at his approach. He broke down every part of his process, including his airplane, his team, his communication, and his overall infrastructure, and rebuilt it around one clear goal. In 2016 he became World Champion. Watch this episode of Between Two Wings to hear Dolderer's full story, from his first flight in 2009 to becoming a world champion: https://lnkd.in/ecrbn3fT #JeppesenForeFlight #AviationPodc

items.title: 🚜 We closed out our Go Green Week with a day away from the office at FarmFun in Bocholt!
items.summary: 🚜 We closed out our Go Green Week with a day away from the office at FarmFun in Bocholt! Our AvioBook team competed in small teams for a mix of fun (and slightly chaotic) challenges between the cows and tractors, enjoyed a delicious BBQ from 't Barbeknoeierke, and wound down with an interactive walk around the domain. Nothing like stepping outside the daily routine to reconnect as a team. A big thank you to our AvioBook family for the energy and dedication you bring to building AvioBook, every single day. items.title: FLYINGGROUP has been using AvioBook across its operations for a while now.
items.summary: FLYINGGROUP has been using AvioBook across its operations for a while now. Frans Dechaene, Director of Operations, told us something that really stuck with us. The crew didn't just get used to AvioBook, they've grown so attached to it that going back to paper-based processes is hard to even picture these days. And that reputation for smooth, digital operations started to work in FlyingGroup's favor too: it's actually one of the reasons pilots want to join the team in the first place.
